en.title: Disney+ and Hulu Merge Officially Complete This December
en.summary: The long-awaited integration of Disney+ and Hulu into a single app is finally nearing its conclusion. This move signals a significant shift in Disney's streaming strategy, consolidating content for a more streamlined user experience.
en.body:
The years-long effort by Disney to unify its streaming platforms, **Disney+** and **Hulu**, is officially slated for completion this December. Executives confirmed the integration is "nearly complete" as the company focuses its streaming firepower on the **Disney+** platform. This announcement came during Disney's earnings report for the September 2026 quarter, signaling a major strategic pivot for the entertainment giant.

For binge-watchers and series aficionados who juggle multiple subscriptions, this merger promises a more cohesive viewing experience. The standalone **Hulu** app will eventually be discontinued, with its vast library of acclaimed Originals and licensed content seamlessly integrated into **Disney+**. This move aims to concentrate content and simplify navigation for subscribers who currently hop between apps to access their favorite shows. While a beta test for the unified app began rolling out in December, the full integration and discontinuation of the **Hulu** app are expected by the end of 2026, though a precise date has not yet been confirmed.

## A Unified Entertainment Hub

The transition began with a beta integration in December 2023, officially launching on March 27, 2024, for subscribers of both services. This allowed users to access **Hulu** content within the **Disney+** interface. The next phase, announced on August 6, 2025, detailed the discontinuation of the standalone **Hulu** apps. This means that by the end of 2026, all **Hulu** content will be discoverable and streamable directly from **Disney+**. This consolidation is a significant step towards streamlining Disney's streaming ecosystem, potentially making it easier for fans to find and consume a wider array of content, from family-friendly **Disney+** fare to the more adult-oriented dramas and comedies that have defined **Hulu**.

## What This Means for Fans

This merger is more than just a technical update; it represents a fundamental shift in how audiences will access content from two of Disney's flagship streaming services. For dedicated fans of **Hulu** Originals like *The Bear* or *Only Murders in the Building*, the assurance that this content will remain accessible and integrated into **Disney+** is crucial. The primary concern for many will be the user interface and discoverability within the new unified app. Will the curated experience for adult-oriented content be as robust as the standalone **Hulu** app? The move also raises questions about potential pricing adjustments and the overall user experience. While the goal is simplification, the execution will be key to maintaining subscriber satisfaction.

## What's Next

The full integration is expected to be complete by the end of December 2026. While an official launch date for the final unified app experience has not been pinpointed, fans can anticipate a more consolidated streaming landscape from Disney in the coming months. Keep an eye on **Disney+** for updates as the transition unfolds.
